name: datacircle
description: Find the best GTM APIs. Our MCP server is open to anyone, with no key: add api.datacircle.dev/mcp to Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor. It answers from the sheet. list_apis lists the GTM APIs on it, and search_plans finds their plans by API, provider or price.

http.description: Hosted streamable-HTTP MCP server. No account or key needed.

tools.name: list_apis
tools.description: List the GTM APIs on the sheet.

tools.name: search_plans
tools.description: Find plans by API, provider or price. Each comes with its score, the best first.

examples.title: Best API
examples.description: Find the best API for one job
examples.prompt: Which GTM API is best for finding work emails, and what does it cost per 1,000?
